answer: By the velvet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the bridge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
